source.title: Порядок получения субъектами критической информационной инфраструктуры Российской Федерации информации о средствах и способах проведения компьютерных атак и о методах их предупреждения и обнаружения

timed_rules.condition: The KII subject sent a request under clause 1.2 and is connected to the NCCCI technical infrastructure.
The KII subject sent a request under clause 1.2 and is not connected to the NCCCI technical infrastructure.

untimed_rules.condition: Information is selected according to the functioning characteristics of KII objects lawfully held by the relevant subjects.

guards: The 30-working-day period starts when NCCCI receives the request, not when the KII subject sends it.
Do not convert 30 working days into 30 calendar days or hours.
Postal or email delivery is the response fallback only when the requesting subject lacks connection to NCCCI technical infrastructure.
Order 539 does not set a periodicity for accessing cert.gov.ru or a deadline for a KII subject to send a request.
Clause 3 contains no numerical period for proactive NCCCI information delivery.
Do not import the 3-hour, 24-hour or 48-hour incident deadlines from FSB Order 547 into Order 539.
Order 539 governs receipt of information about attack means/methods and prevention/detection methods; it is not the incident-notification procedure.
The order does not define a working-day calendar; calendar calculation is an implementation concern that must not alter the stated unit.
